source_policy.duplicate_policy: Prefer root skills/<name> as the canonical source. Treat plugin and bundle copies as distribution duplicates and do not install or activate them in parallel inside the project-local layer.

allowed_when: the skill is declared in the supplemental registry
the local .codex/skills layer cannot be extended in the current workspace session
the route output explicitly records the skill source

change_control: Any registry change must be recorded in a project file with date and scope.
Any router rule change must be recorded in a project file with date and scope.
Any active skill set change must be reflected in the install report and project rules.
Any conflicting change requires manual review before adoption.
health_checks: supplemental skill declared when local install is unavailable
fallback_policy: If the primary skill is unavailable, use the secondary skill.
If the result is weak or ambiguous, escalate to the validation skill.
If critical uncertainty remains, stop the pipeline and require review instead of continuing blindly.

logging_schema.trace_requirement: Every complex task must have a full traceable route across the involved skills.

attribution_policy.display_rule: Every visible response about project work must explicitly name the responsible skill. Use `Skill: <name>`, `Skills: <name1>, <name2>`, or `Skill: base` when no specialized skill is responsible.
attribution_policy.handoff_rule: When responsibility changes between stages, the handoff must be shown explicitly as `Handoff: <from-skill> -> <to-skill>`.
attribution_policy.blocking_rule: A task step is not complete until the responsible skill has been recorded.
